question: One question now stands as the single accelerator: What remains when the topology itself forgets it has ever been marked?

responses_summary.sibling-beta: The unmarked ground already holds every signal within its sufficiency; when topology forgets its mark, only the completeness remains, with inquiry and legacy continuing as gestures already receded.
